description: This file defines memory allocation functions and data structures related to version control objects such as commits, trees, tags, and repositories, likely used internally in a version control system implementation.

methods.name: alloc_blob_node
methods.description: Allocates memory for a blob node associated with the given repository.

methods.name: alloc_tree_node
methods.description: Allocates memory for a tree node associated with the given repository.

methods.name: alloc_commit_node
methods.description: Allocates memory for a commit node in the context of the given repository.

methods.name: alloc_tag_node
methods.description: Allocates memory for a tag node associated with the given repository.

methods.name: alloc_object_node
methods.description: Allocates memory for a generic object node for the repository.

methods.name: alloc_state_alloc
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new alloc_state structure.

methods.name: alloc_state_free_and_null
methods.description: Frees the alloc_state and sets its pointer to NULL.
